prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A modern, collaborative office environment with a diverse group of young professionals working side by side at a long, shared desk. The foreground features an Asian man with short, dark hair and glasses, dressed in a light beige cardigan over a white shirt, focused intently on his laptop. Next to him, a red-haired woman in a sleeveless black top glances at his screen, engaged and curious. Further down the desk, other team members—men and women—are absorbed in their own work, some typing, others writing or discussing quietly. The workspace is bright and airy, illuminated by soft, natural daylight streaming through large windows. The background wall is covered with colorful sticky notes and diagrams, suggesting brainstorming and creative planning. The overall color palette is soft and pastel, with pops of color from the sticky notes and personal items. The composition is candid and dynamic, shot at eye level with a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus on the foreground subjects while gently blurring the background. The mood is productive, collaborative, and modern, evoking the energy of a tech startup or creative agency.
